intro.title: Color Picker
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build an interactive color picker application using Vue.js. You will learn how to use Vue's reactive data system to manage and update a color value in real-time. The main technologies involved are Vue's ref for state management, computed properties for derived values, and event handling to respond to user input. By the end, you'll have a functional component that displays a selected color and allows users to change it through a color input.
intro.usecase: Color pickers are essential UI components in design tools, content management systems, and customization interfaces. You'll find them in applications like Figma or Adobe Photoshop for selecting design colors, in WordPress themes for customizing site appearances, and in e-commerce platforms where users personalize products. As a Vue developer, implementing color pickers helps you build interactive forms, dashboard settings panels, and user preference sections that require visual selection interfaces.
